purpose: Prospective test of native-grid tiled optical model inference and a physically motivated quality mask. Mae Sai v1 is previously inspected development evidence; Chaiyaphum is a separate untouched event holdout.
source_metadata_rule: Pin each Earth Search STAC item ID and s2:product_uri; record each COG URL, SHA-256, byte count, and raster:bands scale and offset. Convert valid DN with that asset's recorded scale and offset, then clip reflectance to [0,1]. Never reuse the Mae Sai offset for another processing edition without checking its metadata.

development.interpretation: Already inspected development episode only; its v1 final holdout is consumed and will not be rerun. The v2 method may be diagnosed here, but this is not a fresh confirmation.

final_holdout.prior_screen: Catalog metadata and SCL clear fraction only; no v2 method output or reference comparison inspected before this plan.
final_holdout.dry_context_failure_rule: If the 18 September scene is clouded, already flooded, or otherwise unsuitable for permanent-water distinction, mark those pixels uncertain and report the limitation; do not substitute a new dry scene after seeing the event result.

grid.origin: event blue 10 m COG affine origin

A.threshold_policy: Use pinned package defaults internally; no agent-selected model threshold.

quality_mask.buffer_distance: Euclidean distance between 10 m pixel centers, inclusive
quality_mask.invalid_dn_rule: DN <= 0 or nonfinite reflectance is unobservable

quality_mask_justification: SCL 1 identifies saturated/defective pixels and SCL 2 cast shadows, both unsuitable for an unqualified optical water comparison; retain the v1 20 m buffer and report coverage so masking cannot hide a small clear subset.
permanent_water_rule: For event water agreed by A and B, code 2 only if both methods also say water on observable dry-context cells; code 1 only if both say dry there; otherwise code 3 uncertain.

cross_review_limit_justifications.min_water_dice: Keep the v1 substantial-overlap requirement; a low-overlap pair cannot support consensus water mapping.
cross_review_limit_justifications.min_cohen_kappa: Keep the v1 chance-adjusted agreement requirement despite a large shared dry background.
cross_review_limit_justifications.min_event_observable_fraction_of_aoi: Prevent agreement on a small clear remnant from being called a representative event result.

analysis_order: Verify exact optical inputs and metadata before inference.
Run and record the already-inspected Mae Sai development episode with these exact methods.
Verify the holdout acquisition and method runtime without inspecting the Chaiyaphum water outputs.
Consume one exclusive local marker, run the Chaiyaphum holdout once, and record its result whether limits pass or fail.
independent_context_rule: UNOSAT maps and Sentinel-2 SCL can guide source plausibility checks; neither is pixelwise ground truth or human qualification for this protocol.
metric_interpretation: Agreement with an automated optical map, not accuracy.
